title: YourMondayMotivator: Where were you?
html:
Where were you when Will and Kate got married? That is going to be a question asked of us by the next generation. And whether you agree with the monarchy or not a Royal wedding is a sight to behold and no one does pomp and ceremony like the Brits.

For me the cars and carriages were a highlight. No not the mini buses the beautiful hand built limo's and carriages that have a huge amount of craftsmanship in them only seen in Britain.

The wedding also signalled a new beginning for the couple and reminded me that every Monday is almost the same. Ok it's not a wedding every Monday but it is a new beginning and it happens 52 times a year.

That's pretty awesome when you think about it. Not only do you get to wake up anew every morning you get 52 goes at having a fantastic week.

Somone once said, "Though no one can go back and make a brand new start, anyone can start from now and make a brand new ending."

Will and Kate are off to do that now and in my opinion you have the same opportunity. Make the most of it and have a great week.
My best.

Glenn

P.S. Have you joined us on Facebook yet? http://facebook.com/mondaymotivator
